info.title: Agencii Platform API
info.description: Reference documentation for the Agencii Platform API. Provides endpoints allowing you to run your agents on custom backends or on other unsupported channels. ⚡ Live Postman Example: https://www.postman.com/vrsen-ai/agencii-api/overview

BearerAuth.description: Platform token required for authentication. Find or create one inside Profile Icon > API Keys. Example: Bearer sk-agencii-...

file_id.description: The unique identifier for the file. Example: file-0SY0lLXWCSSBIOb2gu8UolxH

tools.description: An array of tool objects specifying tools to be used with the file. Example: [{ "type": "file_search" }]

Tool.description: Object representing a tool to be used.

type.description: The type of tool to be used. Example: file_search

message.description: The message content to be processed by the agent. Example: "Hey! How are you?"

apiIntegrationId.description: The unique identifier for the API integration being used. Example: "dpCD7snQ0tCWrdtp6UhZ"

chatId.description: The unique identifier for the chat session. If provided, continues the chat with the previous context. Example: "plOQeH3hW7UKiACqEdAx"

attachments.description: An array of attachment objects to include files and specify tools for processing. Example: [{"file_id": "file-123", "tools": [{"type": "file_search"}]}]

additionalInstructions.description: Appends additional instructions at the end of the agent's instructions for the run. Useful for modifying behavior per-run. Example: "User name: John Smith"

aliasChatId.description: An alternative to chatId which allows using custom identifiers for persisting chats through third party integrations. Example: "custom-identifier"

GetResponseResponse.description: Response body for the /get_response endpoint when textOnly mode is disabled.

chatId.description: The unique identifier for the chat session. Example: "FVfA971B3fnBH4S1OKlo"

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the response was created (ISO 8601 format). Example: "2024-08-06T02:02:37.533913"

threadId.description: The unique identifier for the underlying thread. Example: "thread_ruUj69CyW2STm8Zog0HXkvIJ"

assistantId.description: The unique identifier for the assistant that responded. Example: "J3NQwdHxqm9jvWFpOwFk"

name.description: The name of the API integration used. Example: "Test API Integration"

message.description: The message object containing the agent's response details.

numMessages.description: The total number of messages in the chat thread. Example: 2

aliasChatId.description: Alternative chat identifier used for persisting chats through third party integrations. Example: "r14ud3CyX21Tm8Zog0HKJkvZJ"

Message.description: Object representing a message within the chat.

id.description: The unique identifier for the message. Example: "msg_nH4zWgFW7dCUoNQ5msLJNBUd"

content.description: The content of the message. Example: "The secret phrase is: **papaya tangerine**."

role.description: The role of the message sender (e.g., 'assistant', 'user'). Example: "assistant"

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the message was created (ISO 8601 format). Example: "2024-08-06T02:02:37.533913"

references.description: An array of references associated with the message.

fileIds.description: An array of file IDs associated with the message. Example: ["file-wRZy12uetHH9dVEpR6PhE92j"]

apiIntegrationId.description: The unique identifier of the API integration for which to create the chat. Example: "dpCD7snQ0tCWrdtp6UhZ"

chatId.description: The unique identifier for the newly created chat. Example: "FVfA971B3fnBH4S1OKlo"

id.description: UTC period start date and document ID, based on the member's registration date.

limitMicros.description: USD allowance in millionths of a dollar.

canStartRun.description: False when access is disabled or the current period is exhausted.

externalUserId.description: A stable user ID from your application. It is stored as a hash.

file_url.description: An HTTP(S) URL for the file.

filename.description: Optional file name without a directory path.

agent.description: Agency entry point. The integration default is used when omitted.

sandboxFiles.description: Files already uploaded into this integration's persistent agency mount. The agent can read these paths with sandbox tools; send images in attachments as well when the model should see them.

consumerId.description: Required when member allowances are enabled.

usageRequestId.description: Unique ID carried into the usage record for reconciliation.

post.description: Creates a new chat instance for a user based on a provided API integration. Requires a valid platform token in the headers for authentication. Ensure the apiIntegrationId corresponds to an existing integration.

200.description: Chat created successfully. Returns the unique chatId for the new chat.

400.description: Bad Request. Occurs if the request body is missing required fields or the JSON payload is malformed.

example.detail: Your JSON payload is missing required fields. Please consult the documentation.

401.description: Unauthorized. Occurs if the Authorization header is missing or contains an invalid token.

500.description: Internal Server Error. Occurs if there is an issue on the server side while processing the request.

example.detail: An unexpected error occurred while processing your request.

post.description: Processes a message using the specified API integration and returns a response from the agent. Requires a valid platform token. Ensure the apiIntegrationId is valid. Supports continuing existing chats via chatId or aliasChatId and attaching files with tools.

200.description: Successful response. The format varies depending on the `textOnly` mode configured for the API Integration. If `textOnly` is enabled, the response is plain text. Otherwise, it's application/json.

schema.example: This is a final message response from the bot.

400.description: Bad Request. Occurs if the request body is missing required fields or the JSON payload is malformed.

example.detail: Your JSON payload is missing required fields. Please consult the documentation.

401.description: Unauthorized. Occurs if the Authorization header is missing or contains an invalid token.

500.description: Internal Server Error. Occurs if there is an issue on the server side while processing the request.

example.detail: An unexpected error occurred while processing your request.

post.description: Idempotently registers one application member. Allowance values are controlled by the integration owner and cannot be supplied by this route.

400.description: Invalid request or allowance policy is not configured.

401.description: Missing or invalid platform API key.

403.description: The API key does not own this integration.

post.description: Returns the live read model for the current UTC usage period and lazily rolls an expired period forward.

401.description: Missing or invalid platform API key.

403.description: The API key does not own this integration.

post.description: Enables or disables AI access for a registered consumer. This route cannot change monetary limits or renewal dates.

401.description: Missing or invalid platform API key.

403.description: The API key does not own this integration.

post.description: Signs a 15-minute upload URL for an API integration with persistent agency storage. Call this from your server after checking which app member owns the file. PUT the file bytes to uploadUrl with the same Content-Type, then pass resource as a sandboxFiles path when starting a completion.

folder.description: Canonical folder below /app/mnt/, chosen by your server for the app member.

uploadUrl.description: Short-lived signed PUT URL. Keep it on your server.

400.description: Invalid path or persistent storage is unavailable.

401.description: Missing or invalid platform API key.

403.description: The API key does not own this integration.

post.description: Starts an SSE agent run. When allowances are enabled, consumerId and usageRequestId are required. An in-progress response may finish above the limit; the next request is rejected.

200.description: Server-sent events by default, or plain text when Text Only Mode is enabled for the integration.

400.description: Invalid request or missing allowance attribution.

401.description: Missing or invalid platform API key.

403.description: The API key does not own this integration.

429.description: Consumer is inactive or has exhausted the current allowance.
